names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9676.html` link carries in its `title`, «Митрофан (Вильгельмский), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's line gives only the bare forename in the genitive, «и с ним Митрофана». `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст., which is the year for all fourteen people that line names. His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Антония , еп. Белгородского, и с ним Митрофана , Александра , Михаила , Ипполита , Николая , Василия , Николая , Максима , Александра , Павла , Павла , Георгия пресвитеров и мч. Михаила (1938).»

attestations.note: First of the thirteen named «и с ним» after the bishop of Belgorod, and the first of the twelve the line's «пресвитеров» covers. **The line and the name link are all there is**: name page 9676 is a heading, the grade and two days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 19 мая», with no narrative at all. The 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs, a company's feast and not a second day of his own. azbyka.ru was not read.
